headline: Strategic Base Fighting Intensifies Along Divided Fronts
war_summary: The latest watch brings a sharp new flashpoint at Callahan’s Passage, where two strategic-base events arrived in the past two hours amid a steep rise in casualties and enlistments; the map records nine Warden bases, one neutral, and none Colonial. The divided belt remains busiest elsewhere. Deadlands logged four events in two hours and nine in the day, with four Warden, six Colonial, and one neutral bases. Weathered Expanse reported 29 daily events, including three recent, while Fisherman’s Row reached 39 with three in the latest watch. Stlican Shelf has climbed to 15 daily events and three recent, and Godcrofts to 12 with four in two hours. These sectors retain mixed or partially neutral ledgers, keeping ownership in motion, though several casualty and enlistment rates have cooled from earlier windows. Farranac Coast, once prominent in the previous edition, has recorded no event in the latest two hours; Lykos Isle likewise shows no fresh turnover after its earlier activity. Marban Hollow has added three events, all in the latest six-hour window, and merits renewed attention.
